title: CNF for a Codec Gate
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with Boolean input alphabet, let $n,s\in\mathbb{N}$, and choose codec positions, a codec case, and an encoded bit. The associated gate formula is represented by the CNF selected from the gate's CNF encoding, with variables indexed by a Boolean value and an encoded bit.
